name: QiYi 3x3 Mirror Blocks (Tiled - Icy Amber)
description: The QiYi 3x3 Mirror Blocks in Icy Amber is a striking variation of the classic shape-mod puzzle. Instead of using color to differentiate pieces, this cube challenges you to solve based on size and shape, offering a fun spatial twist. Its semi-transparent icy amber tiles give the puzzle a vibrant blue appearance, combining a unique aesthetic with a smooth, satisfying solving experience.
